additional_info.subject: RE: ID0385445-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000340] OCPP connection fluctuation CRM:00921001233
additional_info.body:
Hello Mark Wilson,
Hope you are doing well.
We have analyzed the logs you shared from October 28 and 29, which indicate that Error code 1006 is typically associated with WebSocket connections, signifying an abnormal closure of the connection. This error usually means that the connection was closed unexpectedly, which can occur for various reasons, such as network issues, server problems, or client-side errors.
If you encounter this error, you might want to:
Check Network Connection
: Ensure your internet connection is stable.
Review Server Logs
: Look at the server logs for any error messages that could provide more context.
Meanwhile, we have already checked the network connection on our end and did not find any abnormalities since October 26.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
